implementation_boundary: Parameter and accounting contract only. No new household evaluator, macro model, policy enforcement, source default or user interface is claimed.

cohort_identity.insulation_component_scope: Declared envelope work includes windows/doors where required by the assessed building condition; no unconditional replacement of adequate components.

exit_gates.required: All three named components completed and technically accepted.
Unsubsidized total household energy bill is below the prior subsidized comparison baseline on the declared compatible service/time/price basis.
Full programme versus without-programme household cashflow does not worsen from the first day; include initial and all payment/settlement periods.
Exact subsidy channel, beneficiary, state payer, amount basis, applicability and exit timing are supplied; policy scenario is distinct from current law.

ledgers.physical: Envelope changes useful heat first. Heat-pump electricity then uses post-retrofit heat and qualified seasonal performance; storage losses and service deficits remain explicit. Never add independent savings percentages.
ledgers.household: Energy bills plus financing, operation, maintenance and replacement at household cash dates; not automatically government money.
ledgers.state: Attributable avoided subsidy and other source-qualified programme fiscal flows by period and payer; import spending is not automatically fiscal subsidy.
ledgers.programme_finance: Carryover plus evidenced seed/external finance and allocated net available release, less only obligations and cohort/training expenditure not already deducted in that net-release amount. Each dated cash movement is counted once; future release cannot fund past cash dates.
ledgers.macro: Investment/work/training, household extra spending/saving/debt repayment and net fiscal/employment effects require an explicit baseline, imports, displacement and capacity treatment. Do not add gross GDP/turnover/tax/household benefit measures.

period_accounting.price_basis: Declared nominal currency/year or explicit deflator; no implicit2028price.
period_accounting.cohort_release: For each eligible cohort and period, compute state subsidy without programme minus remaining state subsidy with programme, within the same legal/beneficiary/accounting scope.
period_accounting.annual_recurrence: Count that period’s avoided subsidy once for each still-applicable exited cohort. Do not re-add cumulative prior cash or capitalization as current inflow.
period_accounting.net_available_release: Reconcile attributable release with dated public costs, reserves, compensation, obligations and cash availability. Negative net balance is an explicit financing gap, not erased by a zero floor.
period_accounting.retained_release: rho[t] times nonnegative available released cash after obligations; unallocated share is state withdrawal. rho is never applied to household savings or a broad unqualified national budget line.
period_accounting.timing: Use actual receipt/release dates; borrowing or a bridge is a separate sourced financing flow with cost and debt, not a renamed future saving.
period_accounting.acceleration: Completed cohorts and financing/capacity interactions determine rollout; no preselected exponential/logistic acceleration from reinvestment alone.
period_accounting.single_deduction_rule: Each dated cash movement has one ledger/attribution identity. A public cost, reserve or obligation already deducted to derive net available release must not be deducted again from programme cash. Other programme expenditure is deducted separately exactly once.

parameters.scope: Existing building typology, size, condition, heat loss, component sizing and required work content; no uniform household price or unnecessary new independent controls.

scenario_examples.rho_zero: Removes this fiscal funding feedback only; quantify delay or other funding need from the full financing/capacity ledger. It does not erase household physical savings or necessarily halt a programme with other funds.
scenario_examples.rho_one: Retains all net actually available eligible release; not proof that initial costs or all later expenditure are financed.
scenario_examples.illustrative_owner_amounts: 900bn/100bnsteps,500k/250khousehold amounts andSPF3 remain illustrations, not populated inputs.

future_ui: Every control shows units, period, source versus owner scenario, changed assumptions and effects/constraints. No immediate UI implementation.
